causal_boundary: The ordinary non-inheriting grantor defect is a source-backed conditional witness. Actual hosted matrix identifies three ACL refusal bits only; PUBLIC/grantor/application sequence remain UNOBSERVED. Strict111guard is valid and remains unchanged, not an invalid assumption to remove.
application_gate: Predecessor20261020220000 is immutable. Root must record concrete111 edit clearance with Coordinator before assignment. Known E16/retained Documents facts are not global absence. Any actual successful111 application/adoption => freeze111 and separately coordinate forward/fresh-bootstrap compatibility; no retimestamp/insertion workaround.

legacy_acl_preflight.normalization: For each exact target OID, use aclexplode(coalesce(proacl,acldefault(f,proowner))); map fixed owner/desired-JWT OIDs to symbolic identities internally. Treat entries as a sorted set only after asserting no duplicate tuple/grantee, no extra privilege type and exact expected cardinality. Never emit raw ACLs.

entry_rules.grantor: Exactly actual dedicated owner OID for EVERY entry; former postgres, setup admin, other grantor and indirect chains rejected. Owner transfer is expected to remap source grants.
entry_rules.is_grantable: false for EVERY raw entry, including owner. Implicit owner grant authority is distinct and preserved; no raw grant-option row is needed.

allowed_normalized_sets: D: exactly owner->owner EXECUTE false plus owner->PUBLIC EXECUTE false (cardinality2). NULL/default and explicit D both allowed.
I(anon): exactly owner->owner and owner->anon EXECUTE false (cardinality2).
I(authenticated): exactly owner->owner and owner->authenticated EXECUTE false (cardinality2).
legacy_acl_preflight.per_function_rule: Each target permits only D OR its own I(external_execute) set from targets. For owner-only targets I has no external grantee. PUBLIC plus desired-JWT together, unexpected direct anon/service/auth on other classes, extra known/unknown role, foreign grantor, grantable bit, non-EXECUTE privilege, duplicate or missing owner row are NOT silently cleaned: reject before effects.
legacy_acl_preflight.why_finite: D is the documented standard default remnant in the conditional witness; I is exact source-intended final ACL. This deliberately does not accept every Supabase/platform/custom default. If actual state falls outside D/I, stop a named SOURCE_ACL_NOT_COMPARABLE prerequisite; no automatic observer or relaxed allowlist.
legacy_acl_preflight.already_correct: I passes and may be reconciled idempotently. Owner-only helpers with I and external entrypoints with I remain exact. No source-level authorization broadening.

all8_preflight_before_any_mutation: Keep existing postgres session/current LOGIN/nonSUPER qualification, hardened owner seven flags, direct/effective SET true, effective owner USAGE false, no unexpected/outbound/inherited membership, public CREATE false and adapter absent. No fallback, role grant or privilege repair.

Resolve all8 exact regprocedure identities once; require eight distinct existing OIDs/public namespace and no additional overload under any of those eight public names. Capture OIDs; do not drop/recreate functions.

For EVERY target compare owner to hardened owner; exact arg type OID order/names/return type from targets; prokind=f, proretset=false, provariadic=0, IN-only arguments (proallargtypes/proargmodes NULL), pronargs, pronargdefaults and defaults as specified. Zero-arg proargnames NULL; others exact arg-name arrays.

Expected fixed defaults: status pg_get_expr(proargdefaults,0)=NULL::uuid; subject=NULL::uuid, false; all others proargdefaults NULL/count0. These are explicit prospective PG17 canonical representations, not native observations by this plan; mismatch fails closed, never coerces/ignores defaults.

Exact language/security/volatility from targets; proconfig exactly [search_path=""]; proisstrict=false, proleakproof=false, proparallel=u, prosupport=0, procost=100, prorows=0, protrftypes NULL, prosqlbody NULL. No unreviewed alternative implementation.

Embed/cross-validate exact immutable predecessor bodies for all8, compare prosrc byte-exact, including whitespace. The three adapter targets still require original auth.uid occurrence3/2/3. No trim, regexp normalization or general body replacement.

Apply the finite legacy ACL rules to ALL8 and qualify required known roles before any SET ROLE/REVOKE/GRANT/schema/adapter mutation. Missing/NULL/malformed/unknown fails. Snapshot all8 pg_proc non-ACL metadata plus pg_get_functiondef, OIDs and relevant existing role/membership/schema authority. No partial reconciliation if the eighth row fails.
atomic_order: Inside existing single DO/statement: finish all8 read-only preflight and snapshots first.

SET LOCAL ROLE calendar_feed_owner; immediately assert actual current owner, session remains postgres, all hardened/membership invariants unchanged. This uses existing SET authority only; no CREATE on public is needed for ACL ownership operations.

For the exact8 OIDs/signatures only, REVOKE ALL from PUBLIC,anon,authenticated,service_role. GRANT EXECUTE only fetch->anon and status/manage/abuse->authenticated. Four internal helpers retain owner-only ACL. No CASCADE, ALL FUNCTIONS IN SCHEMA, unlisted target, role/member/Auth/table/default privilege operation.

RESET ROLE and prove actual current/session postgres and original authority unchanged. Compare all8 non-ACL pg_proc metadata, definitions, owners/OIDs and relevant role/membership/schema snapshots exactly; ACL differences intentional only.

Assert every normalized raw ACL equals its exact I set, owner EXECUTE true, PUBLIC absent, and known effective role boundaries: owner-only denies anon/authenticated/service_role; fetch permits anon only; status/manage/abuse permit authenticated only. Any inherited JWT grant violating these predicates aborts; do not repair memberships.

Retain the COMPLETE existing original3 guard and diagnostic matrix unchanged after reconciliation and before adapter DDL. Then capture adapter replacement metadata baseline including reconciled ACLs. Keep existing helper creation/private EXEC, transient CREATE->owner SET->exact8 identity substitutions->RESET->REVOKE/effective CREATE absence and postreplacement conservation.

Any error/precondition/postcondition/reset failure aborts the whole statement and all reconciliation/adapter work. No independent commit, exception swallow, superuser fallback or partial-success label.
stable_scope: Only ACLs intentionally restored to source-required sets. Bodies/OIDs/signatures/defaults/config/volatility/owners and all existing roles/memberships/Auth/table/schema privileges unchanged. postgres-owned secret helper remains untouched; preparsed actor helper keeps its separate original strict contract.

helper_and_RLS010.case: Extend existing RLS010 only; no new acceptance case or skipped case/count change. Preserve all existing owner/JWT/table/Vault/public-CREATE and other case assertions.

No shared/public function replacement, key/fault/table DDL, existing role membership or ACL changes. Uncommitted private catalog objects do not commit; no migration replay.
ordinary_grantor_native_regression.qualification: Reuse existing reviewed wrapper exports validateAdmission/validateStackIdentity/createCalendarFeedDatabaseClient/readCalendarFeedSetupAuthority/readCalendarFeedPrivacyPreflight. Same fixed readonly docker inspect db+gateway and supabase status JSON as INT015; actual source/checkout/loopback/container/image/current complete migration ledger required. No status URL/default-password fallback or generic pool. Original SupAdmin LOGIN+SUPER and all4 privacy settings proved on main AND fresh cleanup connection, never assumed from adminQuery/adminSession DSN.
ordinary_grantor_native_regression.new_effects_explicit: Two bounded read-only metadata subprocesses; two direct DB connections (one transactional proof, one fresh read-only cleanup). Original setup authority creates only new migrator/schema; transaction-local SESSION AUTHORIZATION to new migrator. All subsequent owner creation/bootstrap/function/ACL operations under actual ordinary nonSUPER migrator. No hosted/provider access/new service.
flow: BEGIN with bounded statement/lock/idle-transaction deadlines and collision-before-DDL checks. Snapshot relevant existing catalog/roles excluding owned UUIDs; no Auth/business rows.

Create UUID migrator+schema under qualified setup authority, SET LOCAL SESSION AUTHORIZATION migrator. Reversibly name-adapt exact source bootstrap for new owner; prove ordinary identity, no inherited owner privileges, effective SET true and no independent function grant option.

Create inert fixture function as migrator with same representative status header and standard owner+PUBLIC default, transfer to new owner using actual SET authority. Run the predecessor exact source ACL statements with reversible identifier adaptation and no SET ROLE; assert observed three-bit failure/noop state while metadata/OID unchanged.

At owned savepoint, SET LOCAL ROLE new owner, execute actual production reconciliation ACL fragment with checked reversible fixed-target adaptation. Force a fixed post-reconciliation exception, rollback-to/release savepoint, restore ordinary identity and assert exact pre-branch ACL/metadata conservation. This is one planned negative branch, not a retry.

Then execute owner-context fragment successfully once, reset/requalify, assert intended strict raw/effective ACL and unchanged OID/owner/body/config. No function invocation or production permission mutation.

Close admission to new work; join ALL actual query promises/timers. Full ROLLBACK first, reset session/role, prove same-connection exact two-role/schema/function absence. Close main connection; qualify independent fresh read-only client and prove exact absence, then close. Any pending/timeout/query/reset/absence/close failure retains explicit UUID custody and fails the case. No cleanup deletion/drop fallback.
ordinary_grantor_native_regression.parallel_boundary: Existing RLS file stays parallel; the new regression touches only uncommitted UUID objects and their intra-fixture membership, never shared fault DDL. Amend its comment precisely. Coordinator/runtime allocation must confirm no competing exclusive catalog-proof reservation; if a genuine shared/exclusive dependency is found, STOP for additional exact allocation rather than silently serializing/changing config.

The source helper qualification code is reused by provenance/exports; INT015 itself remains unchanged. No separate private payload automatically authorized.
